title: Senior Integration Engineer - Embedded Analytics (Multi-Tenant SaaS)
description:
Our US-based client is looking for a full-time, remote Senior Integration Engineer - Embedded Analytics (Multi-Tenant SaaS) with 7+ years of experience. The role focuses on designing and building the backend services and integrations that enable secure, scalable, multi-tenant embedded analytics within a SaaS platform.

This role sits at the intersection of application engineering, identity management, and the data platform. The primary focus is on integrating embedded analytics tools into a multi-tenant application with strict tenant isolation, SSO-based access control, and high-concurrency usage patterns.

While AWS QuickSight is the primary BI platform, we are open to candidates with experience embedding other modern, multi-tenant analytics solutions (such as Looker, Tableau, Power BI, Mode, or Superset). The emphasis is on a strong understanding of how embedded analytics work in SaaS environments, rather than on expertise in a single tool.

This is a senior-level role with meaningful influence over analytics architecture, security considerations, and integration standards across the platform.

Our client provides integrated software and marketing solutions for the hospitality industry, specializing in short-term rental management. Their platform provides vacation rental companies with an enterprise-class Property Management System integrating booking, guest communications, and financial reporting systems - all built with partner organization integrations in mind.

Responsibilities

  • Design and implement multi-tenant embedded analytics within customer-facing SaaS applications
  • Build backend services that generate and manage embed sessions, URLs, and permissions dynamically per tenant and user
  • Implement SSO and identity propagation (Auth0, Cognito, OIDC) to enforce tenant-aware access and role-based controls
  • Ensure row-level and dataset-level security is consistently applied across embedded analytics experiences
  • Partner with Analytics Engineers to align datasets, semantic models, and RLS logic with application roles
  • Translate analytics platform constraints into clean, reliable application-facing abstractions
  • Design and maintain tenant-aware APIs that abstract analytics tools behind stable, versioned interfaces
  • Build service-layer patterns that isolate application code from direct BI or warehouse dependencies
  • Implement caching, pagination, throttling, and batching strategies for high-concurrency analytics traffic
  • Ensure APIs gracefully handle tenant onboarding/offboarding and evolving analytics assets
  • Collaborate with the Data Platform Architect to design scalable backend patterns supporting hundreds of tenants
  • Optimize service-to-warehouse and service-to-analytics-tool interactions for latency and cost efficiency
  • Identify and mitigate failure modes in embedded analytics workflows (timeouts, permission drift, stale sessions)
  • Contribute to architecture documentation, integration diagrams, and design reviews
  • Enforce least-privilege access and tenant isolation across all analytics integrations
  • Ensure compliance with PII, data governance, and audit requirements in embedded reporting flows
  • Implement logging and audit trails for analytics access and permission changes
  • Partner with InfoSec to support security reviews and compliance initiatives
  • Implement CI/CD pipelines for integration services and analytics-related configuration
  • Contribute to infrastructure-as-code (Terraform or CloudFormation)
  • Support observability through CloudWatch, Datadog, or OpenTelemetry
  • Improve operational reliability through monitoring, alerting, and runbook development
  • Act as a technical owner for embedded analytics integrations
  • Partner with Product to shape analytics capabilities and roadmap decisions
  • Mentor mid-level engineers on integration patterns, security, and service design
  • Drive standards for analytics integration consistency and developer experience

Required Experience:

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 7+ years of backend or integration engineering experience in SaaS environments
  • Strong experience building backend services in Node.js, Python, or PHP
  • Hands-on experience embedding analytics or BI tools into multi-tenant applications
  • Strong understanding of SSO, OAuth2, OpenID Connect, and identity propagation
  • Experience implementing tenant-aware access controls (RLS, role mapping, dataset isolation)
  • Solid SQL knowledge and experience integrating with data warehouses
  • Proven experience with CI/CD pipelines and cloud-native deployment (AWS or equivalent)

Desired Experience:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or some technical engineering
  • Experience embedding AWS QuickSight in multi-tenant SaaS applications
  • Experience with other embedded analytics platforms (Looker, Tableau, Power BI, Superset, Mode, etc.)
  • Familiarity with row-level security models and permission orchestration
  • Experience with Auth0 or Cognito in analytics contexts.
  • Knowledge of caching layers (Redis) and high-concurrency API design
  • Exposure to data governance, lineage, or analytics access auditing

Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with smart and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP

Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. description:
About the Company

Park Place Technologies is a global data center and networking optimization firm. Powered by the world’s largest on-the-ground engineering team, a robust group of advanced engineers and our fully staffed, 24x7x365 Enterprise Operations Center, we offer a robust portfolio of IT solutions to optimize networking and data center Uptime and performance. As the industry leader, our 2500 Park Place Associates provide support to 21,000+ customers in more than 180+ countries. We are proud to service 90% of Fortune 500 companies and 40% of Forbes 100 clients. Our company’s strength and success are a credit to our Associates, and Park Place Life is how we communicate and deliver our culture internally. We have been awarded as a NorthCoast 99 “Best Workplace” winner for 14 consecutive years in recognition of our employee commitment. Park Place Life is about collaboration, responsiveness, diversity, and integrity, and represents everything that makes our company great and our culture unique.

Technical Support Engineer Level 3 – Wintel/VMWare

The Technical Support Engineer L3 is responsible for proactively responding to the technical challenges and requirements for customers within the Managed Services environments. The Managed Services department is primarily focused on delivering the whole solutions lifecycle, including; Presales, design, implementing, supporting, maintaining and decommissioning data centre solutions to ensure the continuity of business operations for all customers. This role is expected to work with other members of the managed services and technical teams in implementing and supporting solutions for new and existing customers.

What you’ll be doing:

· Deliver support solutions for Managed Services customers in line with industry best practice to deliver continual service improvement over the whole service lifecycle.

· Work closely with WINTEL Team Lead to ensure new customers are migrated with seamless handover / transition from onboarding into the steady state managed service environment.

· Implementing new and refreshed managed service solutions for hosted customer environments.

· Dynamically monitor, manage and improve managed service environments. Identifying and resolving root cause of issues and ensuring continual service availability.

· Strive for continual service improvement based on a desire to become a world class managed service provider.

· Contribute proactively to new service development.

· Deliver a high-performance culture in the team with a focus on teamwork, service excellence and ownership for resolving customer issues.

· Guarantee operational procedures and practices are well defined, documented and consistently applied.

· Ensure quality, up-to-date documentation exists for all service arrangements.

· Other duties assigned

What we’re looking for:

· Minimum of 8 years’ experience in a 3rd line support or administration role, predominantly

working within data centre services and infrastructure.

· Minimum of 8 years’ experience with virtualization technologies i.e. VMware or Hyper-V

· Minimum of 7 years’ experience with Server operating systems; Windows Server, Linux or Unix.

· Detailed technical understanding of other datacenter technologies including storage, backup, disaster recovery and security.

· Storage connectivity experience within vCenter for troubleshooting

· OEM knowledge-based competencies, preferred.

· Ability to understand and navigate technical situations with strong problem-solving and remedy skills.

· Experience in technical project management.

· Experience in producing low-level technical designs and supporting implementation documentation.

· Experience in performing technical presentations and customer workshops.

· Fluent in English

Bonus Points:

· Vendor certifications a plus (current VCP, MCS Server Virtualization with Windows Server Hyper-V and System Center) – may be required for specific platform support needs.

· Project Management Certification (Prince2 or equivalent)

Education:

· Bachelor’s degree required.

Travel:

· 5-10%

Calculation of severance pay;

Relationship with ADP;

Scheduling and payment of admission, dismissal, and periodic exams;

Generation and verification of payroll accounts and accounting provisions;

Handling and delivery of documents related to audits, inspections, and legal proceedings;

Payment of benefits and apportionment by area/class;

Provision of information related to labor routines for employees in Brazil and Chile;

Issuance of monthly data analysis reports.

Solid experience in payroll processing for Brazil and Chile, with knowledge of local labor laws and tax regulations.

Experience with overtime, on-call shifts, and variable compensation.

Attention to detail, ensuring payroll accuracy and compliance.

E-Social, accounting, annual reconciliations, among others.

Knowledge of labor and tax legislation.

Desirable knowledge of the Workday tool.

Completed higher education in Administration, Accounting, Human Resources, or related area. Mandatory and very important to have experience with Obligations in Brazil, we need some good expertice in this area.

title: Railway Electrical Engineer
description:
Are you looking to grow in a company where you can become a partner? Our core values are the Customer, the Individual, and Professional Development. If this sounds like you, keep reading!

ABOUT THE OPPORTUNITY

We are looking to hire a Railway Electrical Engineer to join our Rail team in Spain.

The selected candidate will be responsible for providing technical leadership in the design of airfields for large-scale international airport projects.

At IDOM, we offer you the opportunity to develop your professional career by actively participating in national and international projects that will challenge you to improve every day, in a collaborative and team-oriented environment. You will join a multidisciplinary group where you will play a key role in project development. You will gain a global perspective on different businesses and technologies in a flexible and trusting work environment.

If you join IDOM, you will find:

  • Flexible working hours
  • Teleworking 1 day a week or 2 afternoons
  • Intensive summer working hours (July and August)
  • Flexible remuneration (restaurant card, health insurance, transport card, childcare, etc.)
  • Life and accident insurance
  • Work-life balance
  • Commitment to long-term professional careers
  • Access to home ownership for all
  • Multicultural and multidisciplinary environment
  • Favorable attitude towards delegation, beyond the usual
  • Mutual commitment
  • Interpersonal relationships that promote unity

ABOUT YOU

Don't hesitate to apply if...

  • You preferably have a degree in Electrical Engineering.
  • You have 5 years of proven experience in railway environments (high speed, metro, tram, etc.). Experience in railway electrification projects in both direct current (DC) and alternating current (AC) is also required, as well as experience in the design, review, and validation of grounding and equipotentiality schemes. The ability to work in multidisciplinary and international environments will be valued.
  • You have in-depth knowledge of stray currents and their mitigation.
  • You are proficient in key European regulations for the railway sector, including EN 50122 (electrical safety and grounding), EN 50121 (electromagnetic compatibility), EN 50119 (catenary), and are familiar with other relevant standards (IEC, EN, etc.).
  • You have the ability to analyze electrical risks, grounding systems, and stray currents, as well as to prepare technical reports, procedures, mitigation strategies, etc.
  • You are fluent in English (minimum level B2/C1) (spoken and written); other languages will be valued.
  • You are a team player, autonomous, flexible, technically rigorous, and internationally minded.
  • And above all... you are eager to learn in an international company like IDOM

ABOUT US

IDOM is an association of professionals whose activity focuses on carrying out engineering, architecture, and consulting projects that contribute to a more sustainable world. The people at IDOM are

connected by our work and by our ownership of the firm, and we cooperate to achieve our greatest professional and personal development and the best service for our clients.

That is why IDOM's core asset is the value and experience of its people. Highly qualified professionals with strong human qualities, deeply united, who work in an environment of respect for their professional identity and freedom, with a strong ambition for progress, development, service, and innovation.

Since our founding in 1957, we have grown steadily and are now a multidisciplinary, integrated, international organization with a presence in 130 countries, where more than 4,300 people carry out our professional activities.

Are you ready to take the next step?

If you join our TEAM, you will be able to develop your career at the highest level, in an environment of deep trust and professional respect.

If you share our philosophy and want to be part of our company, send us your CV.

We want to meet you!

title: HRBP Lead, Latam
description:
As the HRBP Latam Lead , you will be a strategic partner and a key driver of organizational success across our most vibrant markets in Latin America: Brazil and Mexico . This is a high-impact role where you will balance regional nuances with global standards, ensuring our talent strategy aligns with Ant International’s vision of building a more inclusive and sustainable future.

Reporting directly to our global leadership outside the region, you will act as the bridge between local operations and international strategy. You will lead HR initiatives that foster innovation, support rapid growth, and nurture a world-class employee experience.

Key Responsibilities

  • Strategic Partnership: Act as a trusted advisor to senior leadership in Brazil and Mexico, providing insights on organizational design, talent strategy, and workforce planning.
  • Regional Oversight: Lead HR operations for both Brazil and Mexico, ensuring alignment in culture while respecting local labor laws, market practices, and compliance requirements.
  • Talent Management: Drive end-to-end talent cycles, including performance management, succession planning, and leadership development to build a robust pipeline for the region.
  • Cultural Integration: Facilitate a seamless connection between Latam teams and global headquarters, fostering an inclusive environment that celebrates diversity and global collaboration.
  • Employee Engagement: Implement initiatives that enhance the employee value proposition (EVP) and maintain high levels of engagement and retention.
  • Change Management: Lead the organization through periods of rapid growth and transformation, ensuring smooth transitions and clear communication across all levels.

Qualifications & Requirements

  • Experience: Significant experience as an HR Business Partner, with a proven track record of supporting multi-country operations (ideally Brazil and Mexico).
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in HR, Business Administration, Psychology, or a related field. An MBA or specialized HR certification is highly preferred.
  • Language Skills: Fluency in English is mandatory , as you will report to global leadership and collaborate with international stakeholders daily.
  • Market Knowledge: Deep understanding of the Brazilian labor market and regulatory environment. Familiarity with the Mexican market is a strong advantage.
  • Communication: Exceptional interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to influence and navigate a complex, fast-paced global matrix organization.

Preferred Qualifications (The "Plus" Factors)

  • Multilingualism: Proficiency in Spanish or Mandarin Chinese is a significant advantage.
  • International Exposure: Previous experience working with or managing stakeholders in the United States or other global tech hubs.
  • Leadership: Demonstrated experience in people management and leading HR teams.
  • Industry Background: Experience in the FinTech, Technology, or Financial Services sectors.

description:
QUEM SOMOS

Nascemos fruto da união de propósitos entre a Bunge e UPL, uma joint venture de proposta inovadora e exclusiva: levar a solução completa ao produtor.

Somos a ORÍGEO e viemos construir uma relação próxima que simplifique o dia a dia da lavoura, lado a lado do produtor sendo seu parceiro da semente à comercialização, visando uma agricultura produtiva, sustentável e em constante evolução.

Esse cargo tem como objetivo principal atuar como referência técnico-comercial no território sob sua responsabilidade, liderando a difusão de tecnologias (PDT) e o posicionamento do portfólio da companhia junto ao cliente final, realizando a gestão comercial da carteira com atendimento consultivo, positivação e fidelização, assegurando a correta aplicação das soluções integradas sob sua responsabilidade, gerando valor ao produtor, fortalecendo o relacionamento técnico-comercial, ampliando oportunidades de negócios e contribuindo para o aumento da produtividade, rentabilidade, satisfação do cliente e crescimento sustentável das vendas nas safras subsequentes.

  • Desenvolver e executar o plano comercial territorial, considerando metas, potencial da carteira de cliente e direcionamentos estratégicos.
  • Realizar a Jornada com o Cliente por meio de visitas periódicas, diagnósticos, apresentações de soluções e fechamento de ciclo.
  • Conduzir negociações comerciais completas sobre o portfólio de sua responsabilidade, incluindo preço, prazos, volumes e condições alinhadas às políticas da empresa.
  • Planejar, executar e garantir a excelência na implementação do Plano de Difusão de Tecnologias (PDT), campos demonstrativos e eventos técnicos, assegurando alinhamento com a estratégia da companhia, com intuito de fechar as vendas do portfolio oferecido.
  • Apoiar ações de marketing e eventos locais, promovendo o portfolio de produtos de sua responsabilidade.
  • Monitorar a concorrência e identificar oportunidades de diferenciação através das ferramentas comerciais da empresa.
  • Construir relacionamentos estratégicos com produtores, gestores, consultores e influenciadores, através de contatos constantes e visitas periódicas.
  • Acompanhar indicadores / metas individuais e da carteira, visando atuar de forma proativa com as áreas de suporte na melhora dos indicadores quando necessário.
  • Realizar atendimento consultivo em conjunto com as demais áreas técnicas, posicionando tecnicamente os produtos e acompanhando desempenho das lavouras, para garantir a correta utilização das soluções.
  • Cumprir e disseminar políticas comerciais, de crédito, compliance e diretrizes da companhia.
  • Acompanhar junto ao Gestor de Soluções e utilizando os sistemas de vendas da Companhia a disponibilidade de estoque, prazos de entrega e faturamento.
  • Consolidar o posicionamento técnico e comercial da empresa na regional, acelerando a adoção de novas tecnologias e sustentando o crescimento das vendas futuras;
  • Atender e avaliar (procedente ou não) todas as ocorrências dos clientes de sementes que chegam através dos canais de comunicação da empresa, visando acionar as áreas internas responsáveis (quando procedente) para buscar a solução de cada ocorrência e prover o retorno final ao cliente.
  • Informar e acompanhar junto aos Gestores de Soluções os prazos de entrega de sementes, garantindo uma cadencia de entregada alinhada cliente a cliente.

QUALIFICAÇÕES

  • Superior Completo em Agronomia

title: Business Development Executive
description:
Hi... My name is Lena, and I am the founder of Go! Running Tours. This is not your usual job post. Instead of writing a fast-paced, bullet-pointed post with the words driven , team player , high performer , etc., I thought I would give it a go at simply writing the good, the bad, and the ugly about being a Business Development Executive with Go! Running Tours. Maybe no one will reply. Maybe many will. I just need one really good one! So let's start.

Our new Business Development Executive will be responsible for our hotel market in the US, Asia and South America. It is an area that we have not focused on in the past, but we have had ad hoc partnerships with various hotels and in various forms, and the time has come to truly focus and succeed in this market. I am looking for a Business Developer who is ready to fully own and grow this market for us. It is a market with huge potential and with great interest in our running tours, and hotels we are currently working with include Mandarin, Hilton, and Marriott. You should be someone who gets super motivated by the fact that there is no straightforward playbook, but instead a lot of building blocks we need to put together to make the perfect Tetris game. When we have this, the world is your oyster, because what works in one hotel will likely be a success in another, and hotel managers talk. And here comes the true superpower of what you are selling. While there are many local running tour providers in each city, Go! Running Tours is the only global player. So when the global hotel chains start eyeing your success with a few of their hotels, you'll be able to enter into a global partnership. And that is really what we are aiming for!

Our new colleague should believe in email outreach. It is our main channel of business generation, and while we don't do stone-cold emailing, we have had success with lukewarm and hot emailing in other markets in the past. You will be responsible for the campaigns and everything that goes with it in terms of crafting messages, building contact lists, and data work. I personally love spreadsheet work and get a kick out of using data extra smart, and if you enjoy that as well, you will thoroughly enjoy this part of the role. It is very important for me that you have the drive and passion to always reach higher. I am not looking for someone to simply do a routine job and be content when we start closing business. I want someone who is continuously energised by doing more, making progress, and growing and scaling. You should be constantly looking for new and better ways of doing things, testing initiatives, and learning new tech/solutions. We are counting on you to make this a global success (the first of its kind)! Drive and diligence are superpowers in this role!

But it is not all rosy. It can be a challenge for hotels to prioritise the implementation of Go! Running Tours into their services. It is frustrating when we are just about to sign a contract and then our contact moves jobs

title: Sales Director - Enterprise (Brazil/Latam)
description:
Sales Director – Enterprise (Brazil / LatAm)

Location: São Paulo

Reports to: CEO

About Mediar

Mediar is building the in-store equivalent of Kantar Ibope.

Our AI-powered platform measures real shopper behavior inside physical retail environments, enabling CPGs and retailers to optimize trade investments, promotions, and store execution with closed-loop data.

We work with some of the largest global brands and retailers and are rapidly expanding across Brazil.

We are creating a new category — and we’re looking for someone who wants to help build it.

Position Overview

We are hiring a hands-on, enterprise hunter to lead revenue growth in Brazil and LatAm.

This is not an account management or trade marketing role.

This role is for a proven enterprise B2B seller who knows how to:

• open doors

• create budget for a new solution

• navigate complex buying committees

• sell consultatively

• and consistently close multi-year, six- and seven-figure deals

You will own the full revenue cycle and help build Mediar’s sales engine from the ground up — including pipeline generation, sales process, forecasting discipline, and early team hiring.

If you thrive in early-stage environments and enjoy building something from zero to one, you’ll do very well here.

Responsibilities

• Own the full enterprise sales cycle: prospecting → discovery → solution design → negotiation → close

• Generate and manage a strong pipeline of retailers and CPGs across Brazil and LatAm

• Close multi-year SaaS + analytics contracts (R$150k–R$1M+)

• Build ROI-driven business cases and sell consultatively to senior stakeholders

• Navigate procurement, legal, IT/security, and executive decision-makers

• Develop repeatable sales processes, CRM discipline, and accurate forecasting

• Establish Mediar’s go-to-market playbook and messaging

• Expand and grow existing strategic accounts

• Partner closely with Product, Marketing, and Operations to ensure successful deployments

• Represent Mediar at executive meetings and key industry events

• Hire, coach, and lead the first regional sales hires as the team scales

What Success Looks Like (first 12–18 months)

• 3–5x qualified pipeline coverage

• 5–10 new enterprise logos closed

• Predictable quarterly forecast accuracy

• Shorter sales cycles and higher win rates

• Repeatable sales motion and playbook established

• First sales hires successfully ramped

Requirements

Must-Have

• 8+ years of enterprise B2B sales experience

• Proven success selling complex SaaS, analytics, or technology solutions

• Experience selling into retailers and/or CPG enterprises

• Track record of closing large, multi-stakeholder deals (R$150k+ annual contracts)

• Strong hunter mindset with consistent self-generated pipeline

• Experience navigating procurement, legal, and technical stakeholders

• Experience building structured sales processes and CRM rigor

• Fluent Portuguese and English

Strong Plus

• Experience in market research, retail analytics, or shopper intelligence (Nielsen, Dunnhumby, Circana/IRI, Kantar, Scantech, etc.)

• Startup or early-stage company experience

• Spanish proficiency

Not a Fit If

• Your experience is primarily trade marketing or account servicing

• You prefer relationship management over prospecting and closing

• You are uncomfortable with ambiguity or long enterprise sales cycles

Compensation & Ownership

• Competitive base salary + aggressive variable compensation (OTE)

• Uncapped commission structure tied directly to revenue closed

• Compensation is heavily performance-based and designed to reward over-achievers

• Meaningful stock options — we want leaders who think and act like owners

• Early-stage upside with the opportunity to help build and lead Mediar’s regional revenue engine

Other Requirements

• Based in São Paulo

• Willing to travel ~30%

• Driver’s license and vehicle

Why Join Mediar

• Category-defining product with proven ROI

• Strong momentum with global brands and retailers

• High ownership and autonomy

• Direct impact on company growth

• Opportunity to build the regional sales organization from day one

title: Especialista em Engenharia I (Hidrometria)

Trabalhamos diariamente na construção de uma empresa eficiente, diversa, ética e sólida, buscando aprender e evoluir constantemente.

Este(a) profissional terá papel fundamental na transformação de dados operacionais em insights acionáveis, apoiando a melhoria contínua dos processos, controle de qualidade e otimização da performance do negócio.

A posição exige forte capacidade analítica, domínio de ferramentas para manipulação de dados e visão crítica para identificação de desvios, riscos e oportunidades de melhoria, além de atuação colaborativa com áreas de Operações, Tecnologia e Gestão.

Principais Responsabilidades

Análise de Dados e Indicadores

Gestão de Qualidade e Exceções

  • Analisar causas de pedidos/processos anômalos e desvios de qualidade;

Suporte a Processos e Governança

  • Apoiar a definição e padronização de processos operacionais;
  • Monitorar o cumprimento de políticas, normas e procedimentos;
  • Atuar na supervisão da execução e aderência aos padrões definidos.

Atuação Multidisciplinar

  • Trabalhar de forma integrada com as áreas de Tecnologia, Operações e Gestão;
  • Apoiar a execução de projetos transversais e implementação de soluções orientadas por dados.

Requisitos Técnicos Obrigatórios

SQL (Habilidade Essencial)

  • Escrita de consultas básicas (SELECT, JOIN, WHERE, GROUP BY, ORDER BY);
  • Limpeza de dados, remoção de duplicidades e consolidação de informações.

Excel Avançado

  • Uso de funções avançadas, tabelas dinâmicas e criação de gráficos;
  • Automação de relatórios por meio de VBA ou Macros (desejável ou obrigatório conforme a posição).

Python para Análise de Dados

  • Manipulação e análise de dados com Pandas e NumPy;
  • Criação de visualizações com Matplotlib e Seaborn;
  • Processamento em lote de dados de qualidade e geração de relatórios analíticos.

Ferramentas de BI e Automação

  • Power Query / Linguagem M para tratamento de dados de múltiplas fontes;
  • Power BI ou Tableau para criação de dashboards e análises visuais;
  • Conexão com fontes como Excel, SQL, CSV e bancos de dados diversos.

Diferenciais Técnicos

  • Conhecimento em linguagem R para análises estatísticas avançadas ou modelos preditivos;
  • Experiência na criação de ferramentas automatizadas para análise e controle de dados.

Experiência Profissional

  • Entre 1 e 3 anos de experiência em análise de dados, controle de qualidade, operações ou áreas correlatas;

  • Formação superior: 1 a 2 anos de experiência são suficientes;
  • Recém-formados com forte capacidade analítica e domínio de ferramentas de dados serão considerados.

Formação Acadêmica

  • Ensino superior completo, preferencialmente em Logística, Engenharia, Administração, Sistemas de Informação, Estatística ou áreas correlatas .

Perfil Comportamental Desejado

  • Organização, senso crítico e foco em resultados;

RESPONSABILIDADES E ATRIBUIÇÕES:

  • Coordenar e supervisionar a assistência de enfermagem no Pronto Atendimento/Emergência, assegurando qualidade, segurança do paciente e resposta rápida aos casos críticos.

  • Atuar em conjunto com a CCIH, Núcleo de Segurança do Paciente e Qualidade, assegurando conformidade regulatória e suporte aos processos de acreditação.

  • Coordenar planos de contingência para picos de demanda, múltiplas vítimas, desastres e situações de crise.
  • Garantir o cumprimento das normas legais e éticas da enfermagem (COFEN/COREN, ANVISA, RDCs vigentes).
  • Promover práticas de humanização no atendimento e comunicação efetiva com pacientes e familiares.
  • Conduzir auditorias internas, monitorar não conformidades e implementar ações de melhoria contínua.
  • Fomentar cultura de segurança, agilidade, eficiência e alto desempenho assistencial.

REQUISITOS E QUALIFICAÇÕES:

  • Para o exercício do cargo de Coordenador de Enfermagem é imprescindível que o ocupante do cargo tenha registro vigente no Conselho Regional de Enfermagem (COREN), além de estar com as obrigações financeiras plenamente quitadas no referido conselho.

title: Analista de Prevenção a Lavagem de Dinheiro
description:
Curte desafios analíticos e projetos estratégicos em PLD/FT? Se Prevenção à Lavagem de Dinheiro faz parte do seu radar profissional, queremos te conhecer!

Estamos em busca de um Analista de Prevenção a Lavagem de Dinheiro.

Se você quer desenvolver uma carreira desafiadora e fazer parte de uma equipe dinâmica, nós queremos te conhecer!

Conheça nossa história:

A nossa história começa em 1994, na Argentina, quando a GIF se estabeleceu como fornecedora estratégica para empresas. Na mesma época, houve uma expansão comercial significativa, que foi acompanhada por um aumento de casos de fraudes. Foi nesse momento que a assumimos a responsabilidade de garantir a segurança das empresas e entramos em ação.

Ao longo desses quase 30 anos, a GIF tem trabalhado incansavelmente na prevenção, detecção e combate às fraudes corporativas. Uma história marcada por confiança, dedicação, colaboração, transparência e respeito.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Atuar em busca de padrões suspeitos que possam indicar atividades de lavagem de dinheiro para implementar novos controles na solução.
  • Investigar alertas gerados dos controles existentes e revisar se as comunicações relacionadas às transações suspeitas seguem válidas, fazendo ajustes pontuais quando necessário.
  • Contribuir para o desenvolvimento, revisão e implementação de políticas e procedimentos de prevenção à lavagem de dinheiro da solução.
  • Revisar e validar novas versões do produto sob a perspectiva de prevenção à lavagem de dinheiro e financiamento ao terrorismo (PLD/FT).
  • Construir e monitorar indicadores relacionados aos controles de PLD/FT do produto.
  • Propor melhorias e inovações contínuas nas atividades de PLD/FT do produto.
  • Colaborar com as equipes de operações, dados, tecnologia e fraude para garantir a eficácia dos controles de prevenção à lavagem de dinheiro implementados na solução.
  • Validar necessidade de implementar ou melhorar as análises de KYC (Know Your Customer), KYE (Know Your Employee) e KYS (Know Your Supplier) da solução.
  • Garantir conformidade regulatória, mantendo registros adequados de novos controles implementados para atendimento de regulações obrigatórios relacionados à prevenção à lavagem de dinheiro na solução.
  • Participar de treinamentos sobre prevenção à lavagem de dinheiro para colaboradores internos.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Ensino Superior Completo (preferencialmente em áreas relacionadas).
  • Conhecimento das leis e regulamentações locais e internacionais relacionadas à prevenção à lavagem de dinheiro, com experiência em reporte aos entes reguladores (com foco no setor bancário e CVM).
  • Habilidades analíticas e capacidade de interpretar grandes volumes de dados para identificar padrões e anomalias relevantes.
  • Boa comunicação, habilidades de resolução de problemas e capacidade de trabalhar de forma independente.

Informações adicionais

Não é obrigatório, mas será um diferencial:

  • Certificações adicionais em prevenção à lavagem de dinheiro (como CAMS - Certified Anti-Money Laundering Specialist).
  • Conhecimento ou contato com a área de prevenção a fraudes ou inteligência de ameaças.
  • Codificação em linguagem Python.
  • Conhecimento com a biblioteca Pandas.
  • Realizar consultas em banco de dados SQL e NoSQL.
  • Espanhol será considerado um diferencial.

description:
Descrição da Empresa Escritório de advocacia

Descrição do Cargo Estamos em busca de um Estagiário Jurídico para auxiliar nas demandas do escritório localizado em Aracaju, SE, em um modelo de trabalho híbrido, permitindo algumas atividades de forma remota. As atividades incluem elaboração de documentos legais, suporte em pesquisas jurídicas, consultas e atividades administrativas relacionadas aos processos do escritório. Este é um cargo de meio período, ideal para estudantes que buscam desenvolver suas competências na área jurídica em um ambiente dinâmico.

Estágio remunerado e aceitando candidaturas a partir de 4º período.

Qualificações

  • Direito e Consultoria Jurídica: É essencial ter conhecimento básico em legislação, consultoria jurídica e resolução de questões jurídicas.
  • Elaboração de Documentos Jurídicos: Habilidade para redigir e revisar documentos jurídicos com precisão e clareza.
  • Comunicação: Competência em comunicação verbal e escrita, necessária para auxiliar na interação com clientes e na compreensão de casos.
  • Características adicionais como organização, atenção aos detalhes e habilidade para lidar com prazos serão consideradas um diferencial positivo.

title: Especialista em Envase Asséptico
description:
Empresa: DFL

Local: Rua Andre Rocha 3210, Taquara RJ

Cargo: Especialista em Envase Asséptico

Remuneração: R$48,00/hora – (+/- R$8.064,00 - BASE DE 168 HORAS)

Benefícios: Ajuda de custo de R$820,00 + Plano de saúde + Alimentação no local

Horário: Segunda a quinta de 7:30 -17:30 e Sexta de 7:30 as 16:30

Contrato PJ temporário de 6 meses

VAGA PRESENCIAL

OBS: Aproveito para ressaltar que, sua ajuda de custo serve para custear o seu desenvolvimento no trabalho, seja para o transporte, alimentação dentro da empresa e etc. Este valor é depositado direto em conta mensalmente, sem nenhum desconto.

Atividades:

Revisão de procedimentos e processos da produção.

Requisitos:

Mais de 7 anos de experiência

Experiência sólida em indústria farmacêutica com processos assépticos e produção estéril.

Atuação prévia em revisão e aprovação de procedimentos operacionais padrão (POPs) e documentos da produção. Conhecimento aprofundado em Boas Práticas de Fabricação (BPF/GMP) e requisitos de envase asséptico.

Expertise em controle ambiental, classificação de áreas limpas e monitoramento microbiológico.

Revisão crítica de documentos da produção, como batch records, procedimentos e protocolos.

Experiência em qualificação de salas limpas, equipamentos e utilidades críticas (HVAC, água purificada, ar comprimido).

Avaliação técnica de desvios relacionados à produção asséptica, incluindo análise de risco e definição de CAPA.

Conhecimento em validação de processos assépticos, simulação de meios de cultura (media fill) e integridade de filtros.

Desejável conhecimento em qualificação de operadores assépticos e programas de acompanhamento de performance

Superior em Farmácia ou Química ou Engenharia Química ou Engenharia Produção ou Bioquímica ou áreas correlatas. Inglês e Espanhol Avançado. Sistemas: - Pacote Office

ERP Software de Gestão da Qualidade

title: Estagiário (a) em Direito Civil Empresarial
description:
A Irion Advogados Associados, escritório de advocacia com atuação focada em Direito Empresarial, está em busca de Estagiário(a) de Direito para integrar sua equipe presencialmente em Porto Alegre/RS.

  1. Atividades
  • Elaboração de peças processuais
  • Realização de pesquisas jurídicas e jurisprudenciais
  • Análise e organização de documentos
  • Acompanhamento de processos judiciais e administrativos
  • Suporte geral às demandas da equipe de advocacia

Trata-se de vaga de tempo integral, com necessidade de presença no escritório.

  1. Requisitos e qualificações
  • Estar cursando Direito a partir do 7º semestre
  • Conhecimento básico em princípios e práticas jurídicas, especialmente nas áreas relacionadas ao Direito Civil e Empresarial
  • Boa capacidade analítica e de pesquisa jurídica

title: Tech Lead - VTEX
description:
TECH LEAD - VTEX

A jornada de quem ama repensar o futuro está aqui.

Sobre a Rethink

Somos uma consultoria que une tecnologia, design e estratégia de produtos digitais para solucionar os desafios de grandes empresas brasileiras. Agora como parte da Framework Digital , ampliamos nosso impacto atuando de ponta a ponta na jornada digital, da concepção à escala.

Nossa missão é gerar valor real por meio de soluções que conectam times, sistemas e pessoas. Acreditamos que a transformação digital acontece quando estratégia, tecnologia e experiência andam juntas e é isso que entregamos.

Empresas como Smiles, Gol, Santander Esfera, Swift e Comgás confiam em nossa parceria para acelerar sua evolução digital com consistência e resultado.

Diversidade e Inclusão

Para repensar o futuro, é essencial garantir ambientes mais diversos e inclusivos . Por isso, incentivamos fortemente a candidatura de mulheres, pessoas pretas, pardas, indígenas, LGBTQIAPN+ e pessoas com deficiência .

Que tal repensar um futuro mais diverso com a gente?

Qual será o seu papel?

Você será responsável por liderar tecnicamente o time de desenvolvimento e-commerce, garantindo a excelência na implementação de soluções na plataforma VTEX. Atuará como ponte entre as áreas técnicas e de negócios, traduzindo necessidades estratégicas em soluções tecnológicas escaláveis. Seu papel envolve não apenas a liderança técnica, mas também o desenvolvimento e mentoria da equipe, garantindo entregas de alta qualidade que impulsionem os resultados do negócio.

Como será seu dia a dia?

Você liderará o time na arquitetura e desenvolvimento de soluções e-commerce utilizando VTEX IO, tomando decisões estratégicas sobre tecnologias, padrões de desenvolvimento e melhores práticas. Realizará code reviews, garantindo a qualidade e manutenibilidade do código, enquanto mentora desenvolvedores em suas jornadas de crescimento profissional. Participará ativamente de reuniões com áreas de negócio, product managers e stakeholders, traduzindo requisitos de negócio em especificações técnicas claras e viáveis. Atuará na remoção de impedimentos técnicos, coordenará sprints e cerimônias ágeis, e promoverá a adoção de novas tecnologias que agreguem valor ao produto. Será também o ponto focal para discussões técnicas complexas e alinhamento estratégico entre tecnologia e objetivos corporativos.

Para esta vaga, é essencial:

  • Experiência sólida com a plataforma VTEX (VTEX IO, Store Framework), incluindo customização de componentes, desenvolvimento de apps e integrações.
  • Domínio de React, TypeScript, Node.js e GraphQL para desenvolvimento de soluções frontend e backend na plataforma VTEX.
  • Conhecimento profundo de arquitetura de e-commerce, incluindo integrações com sistemas de pagamento, logística, ERP e outras plataformas de terceiros.
  • Experiência comprovada em liderança técnica de times de desenvolvimento, incluindo mentoria, orientação e gestão de entregas.
  • Histórico de tomada de decisões técnicas estratégicas, definindo padrões de código, arquitetura e escolha de tecnologias.
  • Forte capacidade de comunicação com áreas de negócio, traduzindo requisitos de negócio em soluções técnicas e vice-versa.
  • Conhecimento de metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban) e experiência na condução de cerimônias e processos de desenvolvimento.
  • Experiência com versionamento de código (Git/GitHub) e pipelines de CI/CD para ambientes VTEX.
  • Capacidade de identificar e solucionar gargalos de performance, otimizando a experiência do usuário e conversão.
  • Habilidade de promover um ambiente colaborativo, gerenciar conflitos e desenvolver autonomia no time.

Você pode se destacar se:

  • Possuir certificação oficial VTEX (VTEX Certified Developer ou similares).
  • Tiver experiência com outras plataformas de e-commerce (Shopify, Magento, SAP Commerce) e conseguir fazer análises comparativas.
  • Conhecer Faststore, a nova arquitetura headless da VTEX, e suas aplicações em projetos de alta performance.
  • Tiver vivência com ferramentas de observabilidade e monitoramento (New Relic, Datadog, Splunk) em ambientes e-commerce.
  • Conhecer práticas avançadas de SEO técnico e otimização de conversão (CRO) aplicadas a e-commerce.
  • Tiver experiência com arquiteturas headless, composable commerce e APIs modernas (REST, GraphQL).
  • Possuir formação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software ou áreas relacionadas.
  • Demonstrar histórico de contribuições em comunidades técnicas, palestras ou artigos sobre e-commerce e VTEX.

title: Remote Biomedical Informatics SME - 58854
description:
About Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L

Role Overview:

We are seeking highly skilled Biomedical Informatics Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) to join our team in developing rigorous, high-quality evaluation questions designed to assess and challenge advanced AI models. The primary objective is to create benchmark questions that test the boundaries of AI capabilities across diverse bioinformatics domains.

This role requires deep technical expertise combined with the ability to craft precise, unambiguous questions with well-defined evaluations. The ideal candidate will possess not only strong theoretical knowledge but also practical experience in designing assessment materials that have deterministic, verifiable outcomes.

Responsibilities:

  • Design and develop challenging bioinformatics coding questions that push the limits of AI model capabilities.
  • Create automated, coding-based evaluations with unit tests that objectively verify correctness.
  • Build comprehensive evaluation rubrics with 7–10 distinct criteria for each bioinformatics question.
  • Ensure every question is self-contained, well-defined, and completely unambiguous, including all domain rules and edge cases.
  • Develop problems where there is exactly one correct answer or outcome that can be deterministically validated.
  • Translate theoretical bioinformatics concepts into concrete, measurable outputs.
  • Enforce performance requirements with explicit constraints and tests to prevent inefficient or brute-force solutions.

Required Qualifications:

Educational Background

  • Master's degree of experience in biomedical data processing and interpretation.
  • Ongoing PhD with 3+ years of experience in biomedical data processing and interpretation.
  • PhD (completed) in Biomedical Informatics, Bioinformatics, Computational Biology or a closely related field (preferred).

Technical and other skills

  • Strong proficiency in biomedical data processing, analysis, and interpretation , including working with large‑scale datasets.
  • Experience with bioinformatics tools and pipelines (e.g., NGS workflows, multi‑omics, etc.).
  • Solid programming skills in Python / R
  • Experience working in Linux/Unix , Docker and version control.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills for working in interdisciplinary research teams

Domain Expertise Requirements

Candidates must demonstrate deep, expert-level knowledge in at least TWO (2) of the following five core bioinformatics domains:

1. Biomedical Image Processing

  • Processing of Radiology imaging: CT, MRI, PET/SPECT, Ultrasound imaging
  • Automating cell counting, identifying cell types, and analyzing tissue structures in pathology slides
  • Computational segmentation and boundary inference
  • Medical image formation, reconstruction & enhancement
  • Noise modeling and statistical denoising
  • Image sampling theory and resolution limits
  • Intensity standardization and harmonization
  • Geometric transformations and spatial calibration
  • Multi-modal image registration and alignment
  • Morphological and topological shape analysis
  • Quantitative imaging feature extraction
  • Fusing data from different modalities (MRI, PET, Genomics) for a comprehensive view to tailor treatments
  • pattern recognition and predictive modeling

2. Biomedical Signal Processing

  • Cardiovascular/hemodynamic signals (ECG, PPG, BP, HRV, etc)
  • Neural/brain electrical signals (EEG, EP/ERP; seizure/cognitive analysis)
  • Neuromuscular/motor signals (EMG, motor unit decomposition; prosthetics/rehab)
  • Ocular/visual system signals (EOG, blink/saccade analysis)
  • Respiratory signals (airflow, effort; sleep/disordered breathing)
  • Nonlinear, Statistical, and Adaptive Signal Analysis
  • Multichannel, Spatial, and Connectivity Signal Analysis
  • Machine Learning and Data‑Driven Biomedical Signal Analysis
  • Clinical Monitoring, Wearable, and Translational Signal Processing

3. Molecular & Omics based Personalized Medicine

  • Omics based risk / disease prediction (GWAS, PRS, bulk, single‑cell RNA‑seq, proteins / metabolite signatures associated with diseases)
  • Risk Prediction and Prognosis Modeling
  • Molecular patient subtyping
  • Liquid Biopsy and Circulating Biomarkers (ctDNA, cfRNA/miRNA, MRD, etc.)
  • Causal Inference & Mechanistic Inference (ATE/CATE, Trial emulation and counterfactual modeling)
  • Cross‑modal data fusion (omics + EHR + imaging / signals)
  • Longitudinal Patient Modeling and Disease Progression
  • Patient Stratification and Subtyping (molecular subtypes, endotypes)
  • Electronic Health Records and Clinical Data Science

4. Drug Discovery & Repurposing

  • Treatment response prediction
  • Structure-based drug design (Molecular docking, binding site analysis, Virtual screening workflow)
  • Protein structure analysis (PDB/mmCIF handling)
  • Chemoinformatics ( Ligand-based screening, molecular fingerprinting, 2D/3D data handling and chemical space analysis)
  • QSAR & ADMET Modeling
  • Drug–target interaction prediction
  • Drug sensitivity prediction in disease models
  • Repurposing via omics/network associations
  • Predictive Modeling for Drug Discovery Molecular Dynamics Simulation of Biomolecules (QM, DFT, stability, reactivity, PCA analysis )

5. Software / Utilities

  • Tool installation & environment management (docker/conda/pip)
  • Format conversion/validation (FASTA/FASTQ, BAM/VCF, PDB)
  • GUI-driven analysis workflows (step-by-step runs)
  • Workflow automation (scripts wrapping GUI tools)
  • Visualization tools (genome browsers, 3D viewers)
  • Container/VM execution and troubleshooting
  • Batch processing and report generation
  • Pipeline interoperability checks
  • Reproducibility packaging (configs, manifests)
  • Debugging typical bioinformatics tool errors

6. Regulatory Science and Clinical Policies

  • FDA/EMA regulatory pathways
  • Clinical Practice Guidelines & Standards of Care (e.g., NCCN, AHA, etc.)
  • Diagnostic Biomarker & Therapeutic Use Constraints
  • Medical Scenario Reasoning (case vignettes, Differential diagnosis)
  • Data & Content Compliance
  • Ethical Use, Safety, and Harm Prevention
  • Model Use Governance & Auditability
  • Policy‑Aligned Language & Communication
  • Clinical validation and cohort generalization
  • Privacy‑preserving learning

Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Work in a fully remote environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.

Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required : At least 30 hours per week. (We have 2 options of time commitment: 30 hrs/week or 40 hrs/week)
  • Engagement type : Contractor assignment/freelancer (no medical/paid leave)
  • Duration of contract : 2 months; (expected start date is next week)

Evaluation Process:

  • Take home Assessment on Biomedical Informatics (2-6 hours)
  • Delivery discussion(15-30mins)

After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile.

title: Líder Técnico de Projetos de Sistemas (TI)
description:
RESUMO DA DESCRIÇÃO DO CARGO:

Responsável por liderar projetos de implementação de sistemas de alta complexidade, atuando de forma integrada na gestão de projetos e na frente técnica/engenharia .

Atua com forte domínio em SAP e sistemas satélites , arquitetura funcional e técnica, integrações, desenvolvimento de software, gestão de releases, correções e versionamento, utilizando metodologias ágeis e tradicionais .

É o elo entre áreas de negócio, times de desenvolvimento, fornecedores e TI , garantindo entregas com qualidade técnica, dentro do prazo e em conformidade com requisitos regulatórios e de Data Integrity , quando aplicável.

PRINCIPAIS RESPONSABILIDADES:

Liderança Técnica

  • Conduzir decisões técnicas: escolha de componentes, linguagens, frameworks, padrões de integração e estrutura de dados.

Implementação de Sistemas

  • Conduzir projetos de implantação, migração, atualização e evolução de sistemas SAP, satélites e corporativos.
  • Acompanhar atividades de configuração, parametrização, testes integrados, testes de regressão e validação.
  • Elaborar mapeamentos técnicos, diagramas de fluxo, especificações de integração (APIs, serviços, ETLs).
  • Elaboração de indicadores de acompanhamento de projetos em andamento / pipeline de futuras demandas).
  • Elaboração de relatórios gerenciais dos projetos em andamento e dos levantamentos das futuras demandas das áreas de negócio.
  • Atuar na criação/análise do cronograma dos projetos de Sistemas.

Gestão de Ciclo de Vida de Software

  • Planejar e controlar releases, hotfixes, patches, pacotes de melhorias, branches e versionamento.
  • Gerenciar ambientes (DEV/QA/UAT/PRD), garantindo coerência de versões.
  • Atuar com práticas de DevOps, Git, pipelines de CI/CD e controles de qualidade técnica.

Governança e Gestão de Projetos

  • Construir e acompanhar cronogramas detalhados, considerando dependências técnicas e capacidade dos times.
  • Conduzir o escopo de mudança, replanejando as atividades do projeto em curso e, dos demais da carteira.
  • Gerenciar riscos técnicos, impedimentos, escopo e priorização de backlog.
  • Conduzir projetos híbridos (ágil + waterfall), conforme a complexidade da solução.

Qualidade, Testes e Compliance

  • Definir estratégia de testes técnicos e funcionais.
  • Garantir documentação estruturada (técnica e funcional), evidências de testes, protocolos de validação e critérios de aceite.

  • Coordenar o teste de aceitação do usuário e a transferência do conhecimento dentro das áreas afetadas para os projetos sob sua liderança.
  • Acompanhamento das áreas de negócio a fim de garantir o cumprimento do cronograma de testes/validação.
  • Garantir a transferência do conhecimento da solução/melhoria dentro das áreas de negócio.

Relacionamento com Negócio e TI Corporativo

  • Realizar a ponte entre demandas de negócio e viabilidade técnica.
  • Traduzir requisitos funcionais em especificações técnicas claras.
  • Acompanhar impacto de mudanças, propondo soluções tecnológicas que agreguem eficiência e mitigação de riscos.

Gestão de Fornecedores e Terceiros

  • Coordenar equipes externas de desenvolvimento, integração ou sustentação.
  • Validar entregáveis técnicos de terceiros, incluindo documentação, código, testes e performance.
  • Garantir aderência às diretrizes técnicas da organização.

Experiência: +5 anos conduzindo projetos de sistemas/SAP, sendo pelo menos parte deles com profundidade técnica.

Experiência comprovada em implementação, sustentação ou evolução de ERPs, como SAP.

Experiência prática com ambientes regulados (ANVISA) é diferencial importante.

Liderança em projetos de sistemas com melhoria de processos de Finanças, Contabilidade, Faturamento, Recebimento, Controle de estoque e Fiscal.

Noções de infraestrutura, dados/BI e ferramentas Microsoft / Azure.

title: Remote Business Analyst (German) - 54879
description:
About Turing:

Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems.

Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.

Role Overview:

We are looking for candidates with strong analytical and English comprehension skills. The ideal candidate should have the ability to read, summarize, and break down large content into smaller logical blocks, conduct research online, validate claims made in the content through online research, and work with the LLM (Large Language Models) to solve puzzles!

Your role is critical in helping fine-tune and improve large language models (like gpt), and will make you an expert on how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future-proof your career in an AI-first world!

What does day-to-day look like:

You would spend time answering a variety of interesting analytical questions and creating scenarios that can train the LLM models to get better. Here are a couple of examples which models might get wrong and you would have to give the correct answer and explanation to enable the models to learn:

  • Based on a given distribution of sales by month across locations, could you analyze which location has grown the most? (Hint: what time period should we look at? should we account for sudden variability at the beginning?)
  • In a small town, there are four distinct neighborhoods: Oak, Pine, Maple, and Elm. A postman is assigned to deliver mail and can only deliver to two neighborhoods in one day, with certain rules (e.g. Oak is always visited before Pine). If he delivers to Oak and Elm on the first day, which neighborhoods does the carrier deliver to on the second day? Note: No other prior specialized domain experience is needed.

Requirements:

  • Multilingual capabilities are mandatory. (English and German)
  • Analytical Skills : Good research and analytical skills
  • Feedback Skills : Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
  • Creative Thinking : Creative and lateral thinking abilities.
  • Communication : Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Independence : Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Commitment : Ability to commit to 40 hours per week for the contract duration overlapping US hours.
  • Technical Setup : Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelors degree or undergraduate in Engineering, Literature, Journalism, Communications, Arts, Statistics, or a related field. We are open to candidates who do not have a Bachelor's degree but have experience in the area.
  • Experience writing professionally (business analysts, research analyst, copywriter, journalist, technical writer, editor, translator, etc.)
  • Understanding of Excel and Google Suite.
  • Proficiency in Data interpretation, Logical reasoning and Basic arithmetic is highly desirable.

Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Work in a fully remote environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.

Offer Details:

  • Engagement type : Contractor assignment/freelancer (no medical/paid leave)
  • Commitments Required : Availability of up to 40 hours/week is preferred. This role will require some overlap with UTC-8:00 (2-5 hrs/day) America/Los_Angeles

Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.com/referrals , and earn money from your network.

title: Remote Business Analyst (German) - 54879
description:
About Turing:

Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems.

Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.

Role Overview:

We are looking for candidates with strong analytical and English comprehension skills. The ideal candidate should have the ability to read, summarize, and break down large content into smaller logical blocks, conduct research online, validate claims made in the content through online research, and work with the LLM (Large Language Models) to solve puzzles!

Your role is critical in helping fine-tune and improve large language models (like gpt), and will make you an expert on how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future-proof your career in an AI-first world!

What does day-to-day look like:

You would spend time answering a variety of interesting analytical questions and creating scenarios that can train the LLM models to get better. Here are a couple of examples which models might get wrong and you would have to give the correct answer and explanation to enable the models to learn:

  • Based on a given distribution of sales by month across locations, could you analyze which location has grown the most? (Hint: what time period should we look at? should we account for sudden variability at the beginning?)
  • In a small town, there are four distinct neighborhoods: Oak, Pine, Maple, and Elm. A postman is assigned to deliver mail and can only deliver to two neighborhoods in one day, with certain rules (e.g. Oak is always visited before Pine). If he delivers to Oak and Elm on the first day, which neighborhoods does the carrier deliver to on the second day? Note: No other prior specialized domain experience is needed.

Requirements:

  • Multilingual capabilities are mandatory. (English and German)
  • Analytical Skills : Good research and analytical skills
  • Feedback Skills : Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
  • Creative Thinking : Creative and lateral thinking abilities.
  • Communication : Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Independence : Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Commitment : Ability to commit to 40 hours per week for the contract duration overlapping US hours.
  • Technical Setup : Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelors degree or undergraduate in Engineering, Literature, Journalism, Communications, Arts, Statistics, or a related field. We are open to candidates who do not have a Bachelor's degree but have experience in the area.
  • Experience writing professionally (business analysts, research analyst, copywriter, journalist, technical writer, editor, translator, etc.)
  • Understanding of Excel and Google Suite.
  • Proficiency in Data interpretation, Logical reasoning and Basic arithmetic is highly desirable.

Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Work in a fully remote environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.

Offer Details:

  • Engagement type : Contractor assignment/freelancer (no medical/paid leave)
  • Commitments Required : Availability of up to 40 hours/week is preferred. This role will require some overlap with UTC-8:00 (2-5 hrs/day) America/Los_Angeles

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. A Dexian está comprometida com a responsabilidade social corporativa e, investe em programas que apoiam a diversidade e inclusão.

Coletar dados de sites públicos e APIs externas por meio de rotinas de scraping e ingestão em Python.

Construir, manter e monitorar pipelines de ingestão resilientes, com logs, testes e integração com CI/CD.

title: Risk Management Officer
description:
About Us

Established in March 2018, Bybit is one of the fastest growing cryptocurrency derivatives exchanges, with more than 70 million registered users. We offer a professional platform where crypto traders can find an ultra-fast matching engine, excellent customer service and multilingual community support. We provide innovative online spot and derivatives trading services, mining and staking products, as well as API support, to retail and institutional clients around the world, and strive to be the most reliable exchange for the emerging digital asset class.

Our core values define us. We listen, care, and improve to create a faster, fairer, and more humane trading environment for our users. Our innovative, highly advanced, user-friendly platform has been designed from the ground-up using best-in-class infrastructure to provide our users with the industry's safest, fastest, fairest, and most transparent trading experience. Built on customer-centric values, we endeavour to provide a professional, 24/7 multi-language customer support to help in a timely manner.

As of today, Bybit is one of the most trusted, reliable, and transparent cryptocurrency derivatives platforms in the space.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Implement and maintain a comprehensive risk management framework, covering credit, market, liquidity, operational, and technology risks.
  • Conduct prudential and capital risk assessments, including stress testing, scenario analysis, and capital adequacy evaluations.
  • Prepare and support regulatory disclosures required for virtual asset service providers (VASPs) and financial institutions.
  • Oversee Margin-Account Operations, including:
  • Development of policies governing margin lending and virtual asset collateral;
  • Setting and reviewing maximum loan-to-value (LTV) ratios and haircut levels;
  • Monitoring collateral valuation, capital add-ons, and counterparty exposures;
  • Ensuring compliance with client/institution limits and capital requirements;
  • Net-worth monitoring.
  • Review and monitor risk indicators across business functions, escalating material breaches or deviations to senior management and the Board.
  • Maintain independence from commercial and trading lines while ensuring collaboration with Compliance, Finance, and Operations.
  • Liaise with internal and external auditors, regulators, and governance committees on risk management and capital matters.
  • Support a risk-aware culture through training, communication, and continuous improvement of risk methodologies.

Requirements:

  • Legally resident in Brazil.
  • Senior-level experience (minimum 7 years) in financial or prudential risk management, preferably within financial institutions, fintechs, or crypto/virtual asset firms.
  • Demonstrated independence from commercial functions and ability to operate as a second-line or independent control function.
  • Strong knowledge of Central Bank of Brazil risk management regulations, capital adequacy standards, and VASP disclosure requirements.
  • Expertise in market and liquidity risk frameworks, stress testing, and margin-account operations involving virtual assets.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Risk Management, or related field; postgraduate qualification preferred.
  • Strong quantitative, analytical, and communication skills; fluency in Portuguese and English.
  • Must meet fit and proper standards with no disqualifying factors , including:
  • not to have been declared bankrupt or insolvent;
  • unblemished reputation;
  • knowledge of the line of business, the services to be provided and the crypto segment, as well as crypto market dynamics and the risks associated with those activities;
  • technical capability, compatible with the functions to be exercised.
  • not having been previously rejected or investigated by the Central Bank of Brazil within the past three years for submitting false, omitted, or inconsistent information in any authorization request

title: Full Stack Developer
description:
Senior Full Stack Software Engineer

About the Role

We are seeking an experienced Senior Full Stack Software Engineer to join a high-impact engineering team working on a large-scale, enterprise-grade, multi-tenant web platform.

In this role, you will build and maintain a sophisticated web application using modern technologies, contributing to a codebase that prioritizes performance, scalability, code quality, and exceptional user experience .

Technical Stack - Core Technologies

  • Frontend: React 18, Next.js 14 (Pages Router), TypeScript
  • Styling: Linaria (CSS-in-JS)
  • State Management: React Context API
  • Backend/API: Next.js API Routes, Node.js
  • Headless CMS: Contentstack
  • Testing: Jest, React Testing Library, Cypress (E2E)
  • Build Tools: Webpack 5, Babel, Yarn 4 (Workspaces)

Infrastructure & DevOps

  • Cloud: AWS (EKS, ECR, Route53, ALB)
  • Containerization: Docker, Kubernetes
  • Infrastructure as Code: Terraform
  • CI/CD: GitHub Actions
  • Monitoring: Elastic APM
  • Caching: Redis
  • Analytics: mParticle, Adobe Target

Key Responsibilities - Development

  • Design, develop, and maintain high-performance, scalable web applications using React, TypeScript, and Next.js
  • Build and maintain reusable, well-typed component libraries with comprehensive test coverage
  • Integrate and manage content delivery workflows using a headless CMS

Code Quality & Best Practices

  • Write clean, maintainable, and well-documented code following established standards (strict TypeScript, ESLint, Stylelint)
  • Implement unit, integration, and end-to-end tests
  • Participate in code reviews and provide constructive, high-quality feedback
  • Follow accessibility standards and best practices in semantic HTML

Collaboration

  • Work closely with designers, product managers, and engineering teams
  • Mentor junior engineers and lead technical knowledge-sharing initiatives
  • Participate in sprint planning, retrospectives, and technical design discussions
  • Maintain technical documentation and contribute to architectural decision records

Required Qualifications - Experience

  • 3–5 years of professional software development experience
  • 3+ years of hands-on experience with React and TypeScript
  • 2+ years working with Next.js or similar SSR frameworks
  • Strong experience with modern JavaScript (ES6+) and Node.js
  • Experience with CSS-in-JS solutions (Linaria, Styled Components, or similar)
  • Proven experience building and maintaining large-scale web applications
  • Experience working with headless CMS platforms

Technical Skills

  • Advanced proficiency in TypeScript with strict typing
  • Strong understanding of React hooks, Context API, and component lifecycle
  • Experience with modern build tools such as Webpack and Babel
  • Familiarity with AWS cloud services
  • Proficiency with Git and command-line workflows
  • Strong testing mindset with experience in Jest, React Testing Library, and E2E testing

Soft Skills

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Ability to work independently and take ownership of technical challenges
  • Excellent communication skills and ability to explain complex technical concepts
  • High attention to detail and strong commitment to code quality
  • Ability to balance technical debt and feature delivery in a fast-paced environment

Nice to Have

  • Experience in regulated or enterprise-scale platforms
  • Knowledge of Terraform and Infrastructure as Code
  • Experience building design systems and component libraries
  • Familiarity with performance and load testing tools (e.g., k6)
  • Experience using Storybook for component documentation
  • Knowledge of analytics platforms (mParticle, Adobe)
  • Experience with blue-green deployments
  • Familiarity with WCAG accessibility standards

title: Finance Manager - Legal Entity (Brazil)
description:
Role objective

As a member of the Finance team, the Finance Manager of the legal entity plays a key role in ensuring the financial integrity, transparency and performance of the subsidiary. He/She acts as the local finance business partner to the management team, ensuring accurate financial reporting, cost control, and alignment with the group’s strategic and financial objectives.

The role encompasses full responsibility for accounting, controlling and financial planning activities at the subsidiary level – ensuring compliance with local regulations while adhering to group policies and standards. The ideal candidate combines a strong technical finance background with entrepreneurial spirit, operational understanding and a hands-on approach to support the entity’s sustainable growth and profitability.

Reporting lines and interactions

This position reports directly to the Group CFO and functionally collaborates with the Finance Manager in Switzerland. The Finance Manager also works closely with the local Management team and collaborates with the HR Lead in Switzerland.

Key responsibilities

  • Oversee all financial operations of the legal entity incl. maintain the day-to-day accounting of the Subsidiary (invoicing, bank reconciliation, GL entries, provisions)
  • Ensure timely and accurate month-end, quarter-end, and year-end closings in line with group deadlines and standards
  • Prepare monthly management reports, variance analyses, and performance dashboards for both local management and Group Finance
  • Develop, monitor, and analyze annual budgets and rolling forecasts, identifying risks and opportunities
  • Control and analyze production, sales, and overhead costs; ensure proper allocation and transparency of cost structures
  • Manage cash flow, working capital, and intercompany transactions, ensuring liquidity and compliance with group treasury policies
  • Support audits (internal and external) and ensure adherence to internal control standards and regulatory requirements
  • Coordinate local tax filings and liaise with external auditors, tax advisors, and authorities as required
  • Act as a financial business partner to the local management team, providing decision support and strategic financial insights
  • Drive process improvement and digitalization initiatives within Finance (ERP enhancements, automation, reporting tools)
  • Ensure alignment of local finance processes with global policies, and actively contribute to group-wide finance projects

Additional Responsibilities (HR & Office Management)

  • Support in HR administration, including employee onboarding/offboarding, contract preparation and maintenance of personnel records. Cooperate with global HR.
  • Manage payroll processing and ensure compliance with local labor laws, social security obligations and internal controls.
  • Coordinate office management activities, including facilities coordination, vendor management and ensuring smooth daily office operation.

Qualifications

  • University degree in Finance, Business Administration, or Industrial Engineering (Bachelor’s or Master’s level).

Experience / Skills

  • Minimum of 5 years’ experience in controlling, preferably in a technology-driven company
  • Strong understanding of accounting, controlling, budgeting and financial reporting process
  • Experience with ERP systems (Odoo experience is a plus) and excellent command of Excel
  • Knowledge of local statutory accounting and tax requirements
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with high attention to detail
  • Knowledge of English and French is an advantage
  • Proactive, structured and capable of working independently as well as collaboratively with technical teams
  • Hands-on, proactive and solution-oriented with a strong sense of ownership
  • Strong communication skills, able to translate complex financial data into actionable insights

title: PMO
